after.title: Irish Wolfhound Memorial Urn with Silver Relief Portrait, Personalized Wooden Keepsake for Your Pet
after.description: Made to order and set with a silver plated Irish Wolfhound relief, this wooden urn gives the ashes of your dog a dignified home. It looks at home on a shelf, a mantel or a sideboard, wherever you like...
